**Operating Temperature Range**

The NE301 has an operating temperature range of **−20°C to +50°C**, rated for extreme outdoor environments. [1] [2]

The IP67-rated enclosure handles dust and sustained water immersion (1 m for 30 minutes), supporting deployment across winter lows down to −20°C and summer highs up to +50°C. [1] [6]

**Cold-Climate Note**

At −20°C, effective alkaline AA battery capacity drops approximately 25–35% compared to room temperature, so lithium AA cells are recommended for cold-climate deployments, as they retain roughly 85–90% capacity at −20°C. [6]
